extension.news:
Version 0.2.6 - MDBList: new source — user lists, top 50 public lists, official curated lists, and external/linked lists (IMDb, Trakt, Letterboxd, etc.) via API key (free 1,000 req/day) - Trakt: added popular, trending, and official public lists alongside user lists - Added "Allow Community Lists" setting to Trakt and MDBList tabs (off by default) to gate non-user lists - Removed IMDB source (replaced by MDBList)
Version 0.2.4 - Generated playlists keep the order the source API returns items in (no more year/episode re-sorting)
Version 0.2.3 New sources and modules - OpenRouter AI module: natural-language prompts build smartplaylists in Trakt format - model picker (free/BYOK tagged, preselects current), always-on AI proofreading (title + prompt), manual rules, Regenerate, auto-rebuild after add/edit, auto-add to selection - IMDB user lists: full Trakt-parity parsing (CSV export with page-scrape fallback) - Trakt person credits: per-person Movies / TV Shows playlists from cast
AI reliability and cost - Model chain sticks to the user's configured model first, then rolls through live free models (includes free BYOK); hard wall-clock timeout; bounded roll; never logs API keys; standard API error notifications - Default model: cohere/north-mini-code:free (free, fast)
Matching and output - Entries matched to real library titles/files: unique-id wins, title matches must agree on year, episodes match by show+season+episode - AI returns episode numbers, years, and reference IDs (imdb/tmdb/trakt/tvdb); no entry limit; chronological ordering - File-name collision handling; auto Container.Refresh after builds
Reliability fixes - Stale "build running" lock auto-expires; failed builds no longer record a build timestamp; missing XSP files are rebuilt on startup/auto-runs; progress dialog always closed; faster library matching
